references.title: 最低工資法 §5
references.locator: 勞工與雇主雙方議定之工資，不得低於最低工資

description: Holds a monthly agreed wage, including fixed allowances, to the minimum monthly wage; part-time, sheltered and household domestic workers are judged by their own rules.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §32(2)
references.locator: 延長之工作時間連同正常工作時間，一日不得超過十二小時

description: Refuses a roster day whose actual work, overtime included, exceeds twelve hours, unless a filed responsibility-system agreement applies.

references.title: 最低工資法 §5
references.locator: 勞工與雇主雙方議定之工資，不得低於最低工資

description: Holds an hourly rate, and a daily rate converted at the contract’s normal hours, to the minimum hourly wage; sheltered and household domestic workers are excluded.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §45
references.locator: 雇主不得僱用未滿十五歲之人從事工作

description: Refuses employment of a worker under fifteen unless the contract records the graduation certificate or authority permit required by 勞動基準法 §45.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §44, §47, §48
references.locator: 童工每日之工作時間不得超過八小時，每週之工作時間不得超過四十小時

description: Holds a worker under sixteen to eight normal hours a day and forty normal hours a week.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §35; Ministry of Labour rest-time guidance (2025-09-05)
references.locator: four hours of continuous work require thirty continuous minutes of rest

description: Requires thirty continuous minutes of rest after more than four continuous hours of actual work.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §30(1)
references.locator: 勞工正常工作時間，每日不得超過八小時，每週不得超過四十小時

description: Holds actual work without planned overtime to eight hours a day, unless responsibility-system or flexible-working-time rules apply.

references.title: 勞動部 111年8月 公告
references.locator: 自8月10日起新聘及續轉聘家事移工月薪調為2萬元

description: Holds a full-time household domestic caregiver’s or helper’s monthly wage on a contract starting on or after 2022-08-10 to the Ministry of Labour’s NT$20,000 standard.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §32(2)
references.locator: 延長之工作時間連同正常工作時間，一日不得超過十二小時

description: Limits planned overtime to four hours a day so planned work stays within the twelve-hour daily cap.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §35; Ministry of Labour rest-time guidance (2025-09-05)
references.locator: four hours of continuous work require thirty continuous minutes of rest

description: Requires thirty continuous minutes of rest when planned overtime runs beyond four continuous hours.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §30(5)–(6)
references.locator: 出勤紀錄，應逐日記載勞工出勤情形至分鐘為止

description: Refuses planned overtime on a day without a minute-level actual attendance record.

references.title: Disability Rights Act §40, §41, §42
references.locator: agreed productivity wage only for legally sheltered employment

description: Requires the vocational assessment, signed productivity-wage agreement and local-authority filing before a sheltered employment wage is accepted.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §9
references.locator: the contract term and its category

description: Admits only the statutory work categories and residency statuses this jurisdiction recognises.

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §4; 性別平等工作法 §14
references.quote: 普通傷病假一年內未超過三十日部分，工資折半發給 — shared by the outpatient, hospitalised and menstrual rows; a single entry straddling the limit is split onto the unpaid row.

description: Meters ordinary and hospitalised sick leave and menstrual leave against the annual half-pay pool, the two-year hospitalised limit and the monthly menstrual day.

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §2
references.quote: 結婚者給予婚假 — eight days to 2026-09-30, fourteen from 2026-10-01.

description: Limits marriage leave to the days of the version in force: eight before 2026-10-01 and fourteen after.

references.title: 大量解僱勞工保護法 §2(1): the first four thresholds count the workforce of the same 廠場

description: Requires a native terms.worksite on every site-counted employment so the mass-layoff thresholds can be applied per 廠場.
